items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: "he might go hear a band like Sidney Desbyne playing"

ctx.x: that reminds me what are some of the early tunes that you remember I mean way way back well it was a lot of popular tunes we played you know oh I can't remember played so many tunes most of the tunes buddy played with a lot of the red books you know what I'm saying yeah I don't know now he couldn't read but I mean he played the numbers

of course I couldn't tell you whether he was playing them right or not you know see I was young but he played them pretty good what about and then he played the blues you know and he'd make up little numbers he had numbers you know and play those you know I just remember but we played a lot of the popular numbers like they do today the band you know he'd hear them you know hear this band he might go hear King Oliver play it uh no Joe Oliver wasn't there he was gone he might go hear a band like Sidney Desbyne…
